full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white street photograph shows a solitary seated figure beneath a large dark tree on a cobbled square. The camera is very low, so coarse paving stones fill the bottom half and their irregular highlights lead toward a bright horizon. The tree rises just right of center, its thick trunk dividing into twisting branches that spread across nearly the entire top edge. Dense fine foliage turns much of the upper frame black, while gaps reveal a luminous cloudy sky. On the left, a row of pale multi-story facades recedes toward the center. Their repeated windows and narrow iron balconies form a restrained vertical grid. A small traditional wall lamp projects into the bright gap between the buildings. On the far right, a darker building edge closes the view. Near the base of the tree, a single person sits on a low ledge in profile, head inclined toward an object in the hands. The figure is almost entirely black against the sky, with no readable face or clothing detail. The bright opening behind them separates the silhouette from the tree trunk and the street. Strong backlight from the distant cloudy sky sends the ground into deep foreground shadow, though scattered light picks out the upper edges of individual stones. The tree's dark organic branching balances the built facades' straight repeated lines. Grayscale values range from almost white sky to inky bark and cobbles, with soft middle tones in the walls. The photograph retains grain and gentle haze in the distance, while near paving remains rough and tactile. No visible signs or readable text appear. The overall composition is quiet and expansive, giving a tiny still human gesture weight through dramatic scale, low viewpoint, and luminous negative space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白街头照片呈现一名独坐人影，在石板广场上的大黑树下。相机位置很低，粗糙铺石填满下半幅，不规则亮部把视线引向明亮地平线。大树在中央稍右升起，粗树干分成扭曲枝条，几乎伸遍上缘。密细枝叶让上部大部分转黑，缝隙中露出明亮多云天空。左侧一排浅色多层建筑向中央退远，重复窗洞和窄铁栏阳台形成克制竖向网格。一盏小型传统壁灯探进楼间明亮空隙。最右一栋较暗建筑的边缘收住视野。树脚附近，一人在低矮边沿上侧身坐着，头朝手中的物件低下。人物对着天空几乎全黑，看不清面孔和衣服细节。身后亮口把剪影与树干及街道分开。来自远处云天的强逆光令前景地面沉入深影，但散光仍挑出单块石头的上缘。树木的深色有机分叉平衡建筑立面的笔直重复线。灰阶从几乎白色天空到墨黑树皮与石块，墙体保留柔和中间调。照片在远处有颗粒与轻雾，近处铺石仍粗糙可触。没有显著标牌或可读文字。整体构图安静而宽阔，以强烈尺度、低视点和发亮留白赋予微小静止的人类动作分量。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white photography uses a full tonal span from bright misty white to near-solid black. Backlighting turns small focal forms into silhouettes while retaining scattered highlights on rough near surfaces. A low viewpoint exaggerates the foreground texture and creates a strong path toward a pale opening in the distance. Dark branching masses and straight repeated lines counterbalance each other, giving the composition both organic movement and orderly structure. Fine grain and atmospheric haze soften distant edges, whereas nearby texture stays crisp and irregular. Large areas of negative space surround a small still focal accent. The strongest contrast sits where the dark shape meets the bright middle ground; outer regions step down through nuanced gray. The overall effect is contemplative and cinematic, with scale and value relationships doing more work than color or descriptive detail.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白摄影使用从发雾亮白到近乎实黑的完整灰阶。逆光把细小焦点形体变成剪影，同时在粗糙近处表面保留散落高光。低视点夸张前景肌理，并形成通向远处浅亮开口的强路径。深色分叉体块与笔直重复线互相对重，让构图兼具有机动势和有序结构。细颗粒与大气薄雾柔化远处边缘，近处肌理则清晰而不规则。大片留白围绕小小静止焦点重音。最强对比落在深形与明亮中景相遇处；外围通过细腻灰阶逐级降低。整体效果沉思且有电影感，尺度与明度关系比颜色或描摹细节承担更多工作。
theme_en: A solitary seated figure beneath a dark tree on a cobbled square
theme_zh: 石板广场上，一名独坐人影位于深色大树下
name: Rui Palha
